We chose this hotel for our 3 nights and 4 days holiday. I decided based entirely on the score, but after reading the comments, you should decide carefully what you want to give and what you want to get. I think the price/performance/quality balance is good. The swimming pool is sufficient, there are 2 slides for children. The beach is beautiful, mixed sand/stone (we entered comfortably with sea shoes). And the food, day 1 "asia night", the food was generally very good. Day 2 was "fish night", day 3 was "international night", but we didn't see anything international at all. But I would like to thank Mr. Şener, who makes delicious pitas every evening. The "Paris Brest" we ate after our first dinner was wonderful, it was freshly made and served. The breakfast is varied and sufficient. Thanks also to the master who made delicious pastries every morning (they were finished the moment they came out of the oven). We chose a standard bunk bed room with our 2 children, the room was small, there was only the bed and the bunk bed next to it, we could not open our suitcase easily. I read about flies and insects and yes there are, the kids were a little scared when they encountered 3 spiders and 2-3 mosquitoes, but we managed. We did not find the dessert buffet in the patisserie section and lunch/dinner section sufficient and diverse. It's always the same desserts and unfortunately there is no dessert that can be eaten properly (if Paris was Brest, of course). There was live music on Wednesday and Friday and it was fun. The hotel staff consists of young people, they are generally caring and friendly. Ms. Helin, who came to us at the beach and asked if we needed anything, accompanied us to the pool, thank you (a bit confusing on the first day). So overall we were satisfied.

My overall comment for the hotel would 4/5. Actually I'd also rate 5/5 but in comparison with other hotels, the distances between the room and the sea was quite sloppy. You don't have to climb all the way for your room thanks to elevator but to reach out the elevators is another adventure. Nevertheless, the staff, the cleanliness, foods, etc... were all beyond of my expectations. I can consider to go there again.

We had 2 rooms, both had slight sewage smell, the staff response to that was that the resort is full so nothing can be done. The AC fan made a really loud noise in one of the rooms when it was one or high, so we kept it at low. If you open the balcony door the AC turns off and there is no screen door/window so we woke up with mosquito bites. Overall the rooms were blunt, of poor condition, as was the entire resort.

There is almost no sand as the already small beach is jam-packed with loungers. There are boats going up and down past the small beach all the time. The bay is lined with party hotels that have music blaring until all hours of the morning. The staff are rude and could not be bothered to assist or even do their jobs (with the exclusion of the waiters at the 24/7 restaurant). No one provided any information on hot the hotel runs, ie. when which restaurants were open or how that worked, or showed or even told us where to find anything. The guests by and large seem to come for the endless food and drinks, and generally were unfriendly and rude, pushing in queues as if food would run out.

Good food options every day, the 24/7 restaurant and snack bars also offer good options. The resort overall was really enjoyable, with a decently priced spa with friendly and experienced staff. However the rooms could be cleaned better, we found dusty floors on the day we arrived around the bedside tables. The pools (indoors and outdoors) are quite cold, should be warmer. Overall was an enjoyable stay.
